newsitem.title: USA: Double Eagle Petroleum Q3 shr loss $0.01.
newsitem.headline: Double Eagle Petroleum Q3 shr loss $0.01.

text.p: During the three months ended May 31, 1997, which constitutes the Company's third fiscal quarter, Double Eagle had oil and gas production revenue of $132,000 as compared with oil and gas production revenue of $129,000, which represents an increase of 2 percent for the comparable 1996 three month period. Also for the third fiscal quarter ended May 31, 1997, the Company reported a net loss of $(23,000), or $(.01) per share, as compared with a net loss of $(1,000), or $.00 per share, for the 1996 comparable period. Cash flow before working capital changes for the three months ended May 31, 1997 was $33,000 or $.01 per share, as compared with negative cash flow of $(42,000), or $(.02) per share for the third quarter of fiscal 1996. Total revenues were $140,000 for the three months ended May 31, 1997 as compared with $143,000 for the three months ended May 31, 1996.
